name: p51d
mesh_airframe: North American P-51D Mustang (FGMEMBERS p51d model)

license.unavailable: upstream ships no license file at this commit (whole tree checked: no COPYING/LICENSE anywhere; README.p51d is flying notes and p51d-contributors.txt is authorship, neither is a license). Section 3.3 forbids rendering unattributed geometry, so this airframe stays physics-only until upstream publishes one.

hinge_note: hinge lines estimated from each surface's own leading-edge geometry (assets_pipeline/estimate_hinges.py); verified on screen by gate5_realmesh, not assumed

category.regulation: 14 CFR 23.337 aerobatic category, applied as a stated PROXY
category.source: the P-51D is a military type with no 14 CFR 23 category; the aerobatic-category envelope (+6.0/-3.0 g) is applied as a proxy. The type's own flight manual (AN 01-60JE-1) states a higher limit from memory (about +8 g at 8000 lb) -- unverified here

n_z_pos_g.source: 14 CFR 23.337(a)(3) (pre-Amendment 23-64 text): aerobatic category positive limit manoeuvring load factor 6.0 -- applied as a proxy for a military type, see category

n_z_neg_g.source: 14 CFR 23.337(b)(3) (pre-Amendment 23-64 text): aerobatic category negative limit -0.5 x 6.0 = -3.0 -- applied as a proxy for a military type, see category

speed_limit_kt.source: unverified here: from memory of the P-51D flight manual AN 01-60JE-1 dive placard 505 mph IAS = 505 x 0.868976 = 438.8 kt; compared here against JSBSim calibrated airspeed without a position-error correction

m_mo.reason: the P-51D manual states its dive limit in mph IAS, not Mach; no Mach operating limit is published

alpha_stall_deg.reason: the JSBSim p51d model states no alpha limit (no <alphalimits> element; grep of p51d.xml, 2026-09-28)

limits.note: Measured 2026-09-28: the JSBSim p51d cannot be trimmed at 250 or 460 kt CAS at 1500 m (refused envelope.trim_feasible), so a run beyond V_NE is unreachable on this model at that condition.
